use_case: AI eligibility assistant (SYS-11): extracts data from verification documents and suggests SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid eligibility outcomes to AC-03 caseworkers
business_owner: Data and AI Lead (company); AC-03 program director for the pilot region (deployer)
vendor_or_model: Company-built feature on the cloud provider's managed large language model service
data_categories: Applicant and household data; income and expense documents; Social Security numbers (benefits applicant data, Regulated); no FTI permitted
human_in_the_loop: AC-03 caseworkers (state merit staff) make every decision. From 2026-09-08 suggestions are off; they return only with review-first design, caseworker reason codes in notices, and weekly supervisor review of 10% of AI-assisted denials
applicable_laws: 7 CFR 272.4(a)(2) and 42 CFR 431.10(b)(3), (c)(2) (merit staff decide); 7 CFR 273.10(g)(1)(ii), 273.15(a), 42 CFR 431.200(a) (notices and fair hearings); 7 CFR 273.2(g)(1), (i)(3)(i) (deadlines); 7 CFR 272.6(a) (nondiscrimination); 7 CFR 272.4(b) (bilingual service); N92-R04 (42 CFR 431.306(b)) and 7 CFR 272.1(c) (confidentiality); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 2.C.11.2, no FTI); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: Pilot (40 caseworkers, 1 region); approved with conditions; suggestions paused from 2026-09-08

use_case: General-purpose generative AI tools (public chatbots and coding assistants) for drafting, summarizing, or writing code
data_categories: Risk that agency data, source code, or credentials are pasted in
risk_tier: High if agency data is entered; Low for public, non-sensitive text
applicable_laws: POL-05 4.9 and POL-04 4.8 (approved tools only); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7 I(3), I(8)) and N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9) if FTI or CJI were entered; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: Not approved. Prohibited for agency data, source code, and credentials; an enterprise assistant with contract terms to be evaluated in 2027 Q1
